text:
maria_csm: Heads up — planning NoraHealth dedicated pool bring-up next Tue 09:00 PDT. Need quota gates, autoscale plan, and a load-test window. Renewal flagged as medium risk if we miss SLA. Can Eng/Ops join?

devon_se: I can join. What's expected peak RPS / concurrent sessions and typical seq len?

maria_csm: Peak ~250 concurrent sessions, avg seq 512, occasional spikes to 1024 when batch embedding jobs hit. Customer target: p95 generation <120ms.

leo_infra: Recommend start w/ 8 x A100. Autoscale policy draft: add +2 GPUs when avg GPU util >70% sustained 3m, scale down -1 when <40% for 10m. Prefetch/KV priming: replay ~100k prefixes before traffic shift.

ops_bot: test-runner created load job id lr-1792. Warmup script: ./tools/warmup.sh --replay 100k --parallel 8

sophia_am: I'll confirm billing/quotas with finance today. Renewal touchpoint scheduled Wed after dryrun. Flag: customer pushing on unit cost — could surface as renewal risk.

tom_support: Enablement plan: 30m SRE walkthrough @13:00 same day. Deliverables: runbook (link to internal doc), access checklist, escalation matrix. I'll create calendar and share recording.

devon_se: Safety fallback: prepare quantized variant (q4_0) for overflow routing. Also propose enabling prefix caching for top 200 prompts to cut cold starts.

leo_infra: Model variants we will serve: base-13b-fp32 (primary), 13b-q4_0 (fallback), 7b-q4 (emergency). Routing: primary->base, fallback->q4, emergency->7b. Rollback window pinned to 15m for quick revert.

maria_csm: Acceptance criteria to mark "green": (1) p95 <150ms for >=95% of requests during a 30m soak; (2) error ratio <=0.5%; (3) autoscale triggers observed and new capacity backfills within 3m.

sophia_am: Noted. If we miss criteria, we'll include remediation + SLA credit in renewal packet. Capture this in the post-test summary.

devon_se: Load-test plan (lr-1792): 20m steady @200 ccs, 10m spike to 400 ccs, repeat 3x. Script snippet:
```bash
./loadtest --cc=200 --duration=20m --seq=512
```
Attach eval prompt set: nh-warmup-v1.

ops_bot: LR job lr-1792 queued. ETA first run Tue 09:15 PDT. Logs will be pushed to /s3/nora-warmup/lr-1792/*.

maria_csm: Who will own post-test analysis and action items? Need a single owner to compile issues for the renewal pack.

tom_support: I'll own notes + AOs. I'll create a JIRA epic and populate with findings, owners, and ETA for fixes.

sophia_am: :thumbsup: Also capturing customer qualitative feedback on perf vs UX — they want per-prompt regression tracking.

devon_se: We'll run the eval harness to diff outputs across models/quant settings and produce regression matrix. Prompt set id: nh-warmup-v1.

maria_csm: One more — can Eng add a PagerDuty alert if autoscale fails to add capacity within 5m? That was a hard ask from their SREs.

leo_infra: Added alert: PagerDuty service NoraHealth-Autoscale-Failure. Condition: scale_count==0 AND avg_gpu_util>80% for >=5m. Escalation: infra-oncall -> eng-runtime lead.

maria_csm: Great. I'll update onboarding doc, send updated runbook and invite the customer to the dryrun.

sophia_am: I'll prep the renewal briefing slides with potential remediation tiers if we see perf shortfalls.

devon_se: FYI — plan to enable KV prefix caching and a staged rollout at T+10m after traffic shift to monitor regressions.

tom_support: After the soak I'll publish a 1-page runbook summary + action items. I'll tag owners and add timelines.

maria_csm: Thanks team. Quick checklist before run: GPUs reserved, load job queued, fallback models staged, PD alert in place, calendar invites sent.

sophia_am: :white_check_mark: I'll loop in finance + renewals for alignment.

ops_bot: Reminder: lr-1792 preflight will run a smoke step 5m before full run.

leo_infra: I'll monitor and be on call for first two runs.

devon_se: I'll be on the enablement call for model/quality questions.

maria_csm: Meeting invite sent. Closing thread — please ping here if anything changes. :rocket:
